item.mechanix.vein_pickaxe.desc: Sneak + mine an ore: breaks the whole vein
item.mechanix.magnet_amulet.desc: Right-click to toggle. Pulls nearby items to you
item.mechanix.storm_rod.desc: Right-click: call lightning on the targeted block

item.mechanix.time_hourglass.desc: Right-click: switch between day and night

block.mechanix.heal_pad.desc: Gives Regeneration II while you stand on it
block.mechanix.fragile_block.desc: Crumbles one second after being stepped on
